findings.issue: Docker Compose DATABASE_URL password inconsistency - postgres service uses ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres} but backend, migrate, and celery_worker services have hardcoded 'postgres' password in DATABASE_URL connection strings
findings.consequence: If user sets POSTGRES_PASSWORD environment variable to secure the database, backend/migrate/celery services will fail to connect because they use hardcoded 'postgres:postgres@' in DATABASE_URL. This breaks the security hardening intent and prevents production deployment with custom passwords.
findings.recommendation: Update DATABASE_URL in backend, migrate, and celery_worker services to use environment variable interpolation: postgresql+psycopg://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}@postgres:5432/crm_leads

findings.issue: Docker Compose YAML syntax error - malformed line with duplicate 'restart' directive and misplaced 'start_period' text fragment
findings.consequence: Docker Compose will fail to parse the file with a YAML syntax error. The entire stack cannot start. Line 86 contains: 'restart: unless-stopped      start_period: 10s' followed by duplicate 'restart: unless-stopped' on line 87.
findings.recommendation: Remove the malformed line and duplicate. Line 86 should contain only: 'restart: unless-stopped' with proper indentation. Delete the 'start_period: 10s' text fragment that was incorrectly left on the restart line.

findings.issue: Missing frontend monitoring dashboard implementation - MonitoringDashboard.tsx component not created, Sentry React SDK not installed or initialized
findings.consequence: Frontend errors are not tracked by Sentry. Users cannot view system health monitoring dashboard from the UI. FEAT-005 monitoring feature is incomplete per plan specification which required both backend and frontend monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Install @sentry/react@7.99.0, initialize Sentry in frontend main.tsx, create MonitoringDashboard.tsx component displaying system health (postgres, redis, minio status), and add route to App.tsx as specified in implementation plan.

findings.issue: Integration tests not executed - no evidence of end-to-end testing with docker compose stack, rate limiting 429 responses, React Query cache behavior, or Prometheus metrics collection
findings.consequence: Integration-level issues (like the docker-compose syntax error) were not caught during implementation. Plan specified convergence phase integration testing checklist was not completed. This reduces confidence in production readiness.
findings.recommendation: Run the full integration test suite from implementation plan section 'Convergence & Integration Verification' including: docker compose up test, rate limiting functional verification (11th request returns 429), React Query DevTools cache inspection, Prometheus /metrics endpoint validation, and docker stats resource limit verification.
